verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence that drinking hot water with lemon juice can prevent, treat, or destroy the coronavirus. Medical experts and health organizations have widely debunked this claim.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple reputable fact-checking organizations, including FactCheck.org, Snopes.com, AP News, and AFP Fact Check, have debunked the claim. Medical institutions like the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine and St. Vincent's Medical Center also confirm that consuming lemon juice has no effect on coronavirus infections and cannot alter the body's internal pH to destroy the virus. There is a consensus among credible sources that this is a false health remedy.
